You kneel beside your companion and extend your hand. Green light passes from your palm into their wounds, leaving your own fingers cold.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Reason
Target / range / shape
One willing creature within 2 squares.
Duration
Instant. Applied conditions follow their normal duration and decay.
Equipment / acquisition
No item needed unless named above.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Magic / Recovery

A green warmth passes from your palm into their hurt. Pay 1 HP first, leaving yourself above 0; ignore resistance for the cost. Requires a free hand. Apply Life resistance to healing, minimum 1, capped by missing HP.

Weak
Restore 3 HP.
Standard
Restore 5 HP and reduce temporary Bleeding by 1.
Strong
Restore 7 HP and reduce temporary Bleeding by 2.

Additional rulings

Offensive healing — latest agreement: this spell may target an unwilling creature harmed by healing. Resolve it as an attack using its printed attribute, range, action and HP cost; the HP result becomes Life damage, without beneficial recovery riders. This is the explicit exception to willing-only targeting above. Use the creature’s printed defense when a player defends; no opposed second roll.
